nameOrigin: to bind with strips of cloth
a pupal casing made by some insects

pokedexEntries.bk: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.

pokedexEntries.wh: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.

pokedexEntries.sc: Swadloon lives quietly at the feet of trees. It prefers eating fallen leaves that have grown soft rather than fresh ones.

pokedexEntries.vi: Swadloon wraps itself in leaves for protection. It uses the two leaves atop its head to detect air movements and feel out its surroundings.
